look_here_first: Turn a leafy side branch OVER. The small oblong leaves sit in two rows and make a simple branch look like a compound leaf. At the leaf axils beneath it, look for nearly stalkless round capsules (fruit stalk usually under 0.5 mm), about 2–2.2 mm wide; use a hand lens. Long-stalked phyllanthus (P. tenellus) has fruit hanging on conspicuously longer stalks, often 5–10 mm. Do not ID either plant from foliage alone.

key_traits.label: Crew warning
key_traits.text: A fruit-free seedling or distant photograph may be Phyllanthus sp.; capture the underside and measure a fruit stalk before species-level confirmation.
